integrity: All bitangent and contact claims have explicit universal coefficient identities and geometric completeness proofs; self-contained exact Python arithmetic verifies the defining identity, but does not constitute independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Only the one-pole order-four characteristic-three Artin–Schreier genus-three stratum; finite-field Frobenius cycle profiles and other Artin–Schreier strata are not classified. Earlier general theta-characteristic theory and the exceptional all-hyperflex member are not claimed as new. Undiscovered equivalent classical formulas remain possible.
title: A degree-27 bitangent tower and uniform hyperflex boundary for characteristic-three Artin–Schreier quartics
